title: Revanced Craft
description: Tired of Java Edition looking and feeling static? Bedrock Aesthetics is a carefully curated vanilla-plus modpack designed to blend the best visual and performance features of Minecraft Bedrock Edition with the classic feel of Java.
body:
![LOGO](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42952e8e7b6c367d3771f24eeb1afd86c5239cca_0.webp)

**_ENABLE ALL THE RESOURCE PACK for better expirience_**

Revanced Craft is a performance-focused modpack designed to bring the fluid animations and visual polish of Bedrock Edition to Java, without losing the "Vanilla" feel.
✨ Key Features
Smooth Animations: Integrated support for Bedrock-style movements and mob animations.
Ultimate Optimization: Built on Sodium and Lithium for the best possible FPS.
Ready-to-Go Visuals: Shaders are pre-configured for an out-of-the-box cinematic experience.

🎨Included Shaders

No need to download extra files! We have pre-installed the best shaders for you:

Complementary Reimagined – The perfect balance between performance and realism.

Euphoria Patched – An enhanced version of Complementary with even more customization and "wow" effects.

⛰️ **Recommended World Gen** (Optional)

For the best exploration experience, we highly recommend adding these mods to your instance:

Tectonic – For massive, realistic mountain ranges and smoother terrain.

TerraBlender – Required for better biome transitions and compatibility with world-gen mods.

**🛠 Installation**

Download the .mrpack file.

Import it into the Modrinth App or Prism Launcher.

Launch and enjoy!
